The Athletic, Boldly Styled Value Commuter

The 2015 Dodge Dart SXT is engineered for the Tacoma driver who needs a highly affordable, dependable daily driver but flatly refuses to settle for a boring, rental-car aesthetic. Built on an aggressive, Alfa Romeo-derived chassis architecture, the Dart stands completely apart from typical compact cars by offering a wide, athletic stance, crisp European handling dynamics, and unmistakable American muscle-car styling. With 150,000 miles on the odometer, this front-wheel-drive sedan has proven its long-term mechanical stamina over years of local highway cruising and is packaged at a budget-friendly price point. Whether you are zipping through traffic near the Tacoma Dome, handling the daily trek down to JBLM, or navigating the tight gridlock along South Tacoma Way, the Dart SXT delivers a punchy, connected, and highly engaging ride.

Under the hood lies the most desirable powerplant in the lineup: Dodge s responsive 2.4L TigerShark MultiAir 2 4-cylinder engine, unleashing a stout 184 horsepower and 174 lb-ft of torque. While competitor compacts from this era often feel slow and underpowered, the Dart SXT brings real muscle to the highway, offering effortless passing power when merging onto I-5. It is paired with a smooth-shifting 6-speed automatic transmission and a four-wheel independent touring suspension that provides an incredibly solid, planted feel on the road. Remarkably, it delivers this athletic performance while acting as a great shield against high Pacific Northwest fuel prices, achieving an impressive 35 MPG on the highway and 23 MPG in the city.

The SXT trim strikes the ideal balance in the 2015 lineup, injecting a healthy dose of premium comfort and tech features into your daily commute. On the outside, it commands attention with sharp 17-inch aluminum wheels, automatic halogen headlamps, and a distinct signature black grille. Step inside the surprisingly spacious cabin to find premium dual-tone sport-cloth seats, a 60/40 split-folding rear seat with a trunk pass-through, and a soft-touch dashboard layout. Tech is modern and incredibly user-friendly, highlighted by the available 8.4-inch Uconnect touchscreen display with a crisp rearview backup camera, Bluetooth wireless connectivity, and steering-wheel-mounted audio controls. Safety is paramount, the 2015 Dart earned a coveted 5-Star Overall Safety Rating from the NHTSA, heavily backed by 10 standard airbags, electronic stability control, and brake assist to give you absolute peace of mind through rainy Washington winters.

Ford's Transit Connect is engineered for commercial duty, which means the components, seating structures, and cargo area are all built to withstand far more than typical passenger vehicle use. The XL trim is the clean, work-ready configuration — stripped of unnecessary frills and designed to maximize cargo space and reliability. Whether you're a contractor, a delivery driver, a small business owner, or simply someone who needs serious hauling capacity in a maneuverable package, this van delivers without the oversized footprint of a full-size commercial vehicle.2018 Ford Transit Connect Performance and Engine Under the hood, this Transit Connect is powered by a 2.5-liter four-cylinder gasoline engine paired with a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission featuring Ford's SelectShift technology. SelectShift gives drivers the ability to manually shift gears when conditions call for it — handy when navigating steep grades in the Inland Empire hills or merging onto the I-10 with a loaded cargo bay. The front-wheel-drive configuration keeps the center of gravity low and improves traction in the kinds of stop-and-go urban driving conditions common throughout Fontana and the greater San Bernardino County area. Fuel efficiency is a genuine strength here — the 2.5-liter engine sips fuel compared to larger V6 or V8-powered vans, keeping your operating costs manageable over the long haul.Ford Transit Connect Features and Interior

Cargo-Ready Configuration
